name: Ga nuong muoi cheo
summary: Grilled chicken with muối cheo and sticky rice is the platter the Quang Binh visitor portal describes on 21 February 2025 and again on 13 June 2025. The February article calls the salt a Phong Nha salt.
origin: Phong Nha, in the Quang Binh visitor portal’s articles of 21 February 2025 and 13 June 2025.
texture: Both articles describe firm meat. The June article says the grilled meat is golden. The February article says the same of the mẹt.
howToEat: Eat the grilled chicken with muối cheo and sticky rice. The February article also serves that salt with other grilled meat.
Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park’s Mooc Spring page names free-range chicken on a platter with mountain-stream shrimp and freshwater fish, and it does not say the chicken is grilled.
A door, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Phong Nha. Neither article names a street. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ga nuong muoi cheo — grilled chicken, Phong Nha
seoDescription: Grilled chicken with muối cheo and sticky rice is the platter two 2025 portal articles describe. A door and a price are Check on arrival.
